descriptionChirho: Noun denoting the time of midday or noon, often used in temporal and comparative expressions. All four clusters share the same denotation with variation only in prepositional framing (at noon, like noon, brighter than noon). Multilingual glosses confirm unity: Spanish mediodía (midday), Arabic الظُّهْرِ / الظَّهِيرَةِ (noon), Korean 정오 (noon), Hindi दोपहर (midday), Swahili adhuhuri / mchana (noon/afternoon). The clusters differ only by prepositions b- (at), k- (like), m- (from/than), and conjunctive w- (and), not by meaning.
